description: Maine Unemployment Insurance provides temporary benefits to qualifying workers with lost work or reduced hours. ReEmployME handles claims and weekly certifications.
introduction: Maine Unemployment Insurance provides temporary benefits to qualifying workers with lost work or reduced hours. ReEmployME handles claims and weekly certifications.

who: You generally need sufficient prior wages and job loss or reduced hours through no fault of your own.
Weekly eligibility requires being able and available for work and following job-search rules unless a recognized waiver applies.
sections.get: The state determines the payment and payable weeks from the claim. Initial filing does not request all future weeks or resolve every eligibility issue.
sections.docs: Prepare your Social Security or relevant immigration information, employment history and a valid email address. Set up the ReEmployME account and keep identity-verification instructions and confirmations secure.
sections.apply:
1. Use Maine’s File a New Claim link to enter ReEmployME.
  2. Complete employment and separation details and respond to any verification requests.
  3. File a weekly certification and maintain the required Maine JobLink account. Unless waived, complete at least one qualifying search activity each week.
sections.after: Save search evidence and weekly confirmations. Simply browsing JobLink is not a qualifying activity. If temporarily laid off with a definite recall date, ask about the current waiver, which covers the last six weeks before return rather than automatically the first six weeks unemployed.

faqs: No. Maine requires an actual qualifying activity such as applying, contacting an employer or participating in eligible reemployment services.
Do I need a JobLink account?
Maine’s work-search page says unemployment claimants must have an active Maine JobLink account.
Does a temporary layoff automatically waive all searching?
No. Ask about the recognized waiver and its dates. The current rule covers the last six weeks before a definite return.
Who can help with claim access?
Contact unemployment customer service at 800-593-7660 during the hours shown on the state website.
